'''Hex Ordin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a famous [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When his [[Hex Ordin's golden blaster|golden blaster]] went missing, Ordin offered a reward to whoever found it.<ref name="TOR" />
